Remote brand design now pays $1,500-$5,000 per fixed project on Loker Dollar — but only 22% of listings actually show the number.

Looking at 3,940 active remote listings, just 853 (22%) disclose any pay figure. Two live brand-designer gigs both use fixed-price contracts:
- Stevens — Brand Identity Designer, $3,000-$5,000 per project
- Sidekicks Creative Studio — Brand Identity Designer, $1,500-$3,000 per project

A higher lump sum isn't always better. Fixed contracts can mean short, high-pressure sprints, while a steadier retainer can improve cash flow and open room to upsell.

The broader picture: 64% of listings accept worldwide remote applicants, so the pool is genuinely global. For freelancers, focusing on the 22% that publish rates gives a clearer benchmark.

https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/remote-brand-designer-salary-trends-2026
